overview: The committee reviewed a draft to modernize the Human Rights Commission's enabling ordinance, evaluated feedback from recent senior center listening sessions, and approved the latest council newsletter with edits.

items.title: Human Rights Commission Enabling Ordinance
items.summary: The committee discussed updates to the commission's enabling ordinance, including changes to membership size, officer roles, meeting frequency, and legal counsel provisions, before voting to accept the edits and keep the matter in committee.

items.title: Senior Center Listening Session Reports
items.summary: Committee members reported on constituent feedback regarding road repairs, parking, and housing from recent senior center meetings, and debated best practices for facilitating future sessions.

items.title: City Council Newsletter
items.summary: The committee reviewed, edited, and approved the latest draft of the council newsletter, incorporating updates on charter revisions, lead sewer pipe repairs, and links to online resources.
